blocks.content: The response to selection is simply the change in the mean total breeding value, which (from Chapter 13) is the within-generation change in the phenotypic mean after selection (the selection differential, S) times the slope of the regression of $ A_{T} $ on phenotype z, yielding [[SEE_FORMULA:22.14]]

The second expression follows from the standard identity that $ S = \sigma_z \bar{i} $ (Equation 13.6a). Substituting Equation 22.12c, with $ n = 2 $ and $ r = 0 $, into Equation 22.13 recovers Griffing's result (Equation 22.11a).
